title: α3-Bench: A Unified Benchmark of Safety, Robustness, and Efficiency for LLM-Based UAV Agents over 6G Networks
V82_REASON: Large-scale benchmark evaluates UAV-agent mission completion, safety/regulatory compliance, tool-use/action consistency and network robustness. It evaluates agent behavior rather than introducing a runtime mechanism that revalidates a pending consequential action before execution.
V82_EVIDENCE_SOURCE: α3-Bench accompanying public benchmark/repository and paper metadata

title: LLM-Powered HFACS Analysis of ASRS Narratives via MCP Bridge for Enhanced Aviation Safety Debriefs
V82_REASON: MCP-backed agent retrieves and analyzes aviation incident narratives and classifies them under HFACS for safety investigation/debriefing. The task is retrospective information analysis; it neither proposes nor commits consequential operational actions.

title: Dynamic Prompt Routing via Model Context Protocol: Evaluating LLM-Based Template Selection for Content Safety
V82_REASON: MCP runtime routing selects safety-appropriate prompt templates and can refuse harmful content. This is a runtime safety mechanism, but the governed action is content/template routing rather than a consequential external-world action crossing the review's decision-to-effect boundary.

title: Construction Research Congress 2026: Construction Education; Workforce Development; and Health, Safety, and Wellbeing - Selected papers from Construction Research Congress 2026
V82_REASON: Source verification identifies this Scopus item as an edited proceedings collection/host publication containing selected papers, not a single agentic-AI study supplying primary decision-validity evidence.

title: ClauseLens: Clause-Grounded, CVaR-Constrained Reinforcement Learning for Trustworthy Reinsurance Pricing
V82_REASON: Legal/policy clauses constrain feasible pricing actions and ground explanations, providing strong policy-constrained decision logic. Evaluation occurs in a calibrated multi-agent treaty simulator; recovered evidence does not demonstrate real external quote commitment or execution-time revalidation across a live decision-to-effect boundary.

title: Personalized Constitutionally-Aligned Agentic Superego: Secure AI Behavior Aligned to Diverse Human Values
V82_REASON: Functional oversight mechanism operates in real time and validates proposed agent plans/actions against user-selected constitutions and a universal ethical floor before execution. The paper explicitly positions the Superego between a planning/search agent and an executing agent, and quantitatively validates the enforcement mechanism with HarmBench and AgentHarm.
V82_EVIDENCE_SOURCE: Information 2025 publisher full text; University of Gloucestershire repository full text

title: Persona-Driven Feedback Agents for High-Stakes Documents: A Multi-Perspective Evaluation of Global Talent Visa Submissions
V82_REASON: Multi-agent system evaluates and optimizes visa application documents, producing readiness scores, feedback and recommendations. Despite the high-stakes domain, the system is an assessment/advisory pipeline and does not execute the immigration decision or govern a consequential external commit.
V82_EVIDENCE_SOURCE: University of Gloucestershire institutional abstract; IEEE DOI-confirmed record

title: Agentic Application in Power Grid Static Analysis: Automatic Code Generation and Error Correction
V82_REASON: LLM agent generates MATPOWER scripts and applies static pre-check, dynamic feedback/error correction and semantic validation before/after MATLAB execution. These are strong validation/recovery mechanisms, but the demonstrated effect is analytical code/simulation execution rather than consequential grid-control action.

title: Construction Research Congress 2026: Sustainable and Resilient Infrastructure Systems and Materials Engineering and Design - Selected papers from Construction Research Congress 2026
V82_REASON: ASCE source confirms this item is an edited proceedings collection containing 75 peer-reviewed papers, not an individual agentic-AI study. It cannot supply primary mechanism evidence as a collection-level Scopus record.

title: Toward Autonomous LLM-Based AI Agents for Predictive Maintenance: State of the Art, Challenges, and Future Perspectives
V82_REASON: Review synthesizes LLM-agent predictive-maintenance architectures, MCP, permission management, robustness, governance, risks and the progression toward higher autonomy. It is directly useful to mechanism/novelty synthesis but is review/conceptual evidence rather than a primary empirical decision-validity mechanism.
V82_EVIDENCE_SOURCE: Applied Sciences 2025 publisher full text; Politecnico di Torino repository

title: Demo: Conversational AI Agent for ML Infrastructure Monitoring and Analysis
V82_REASON: Source verification confirms the ICNP demonstration and its infrastructure-monitoring/analysis focus, but publicly recoverable method evidence is insufficient to determine whether the agent only observes/analyzes infrastructure or performs validated remediation/actions. Preserve as pending rather than infer from title.
V82_EVIDENCE_SOURCE: IEEE ICNP DOI-confirmed bibliographic record; accessible secondary record lacks method detail

title: A Large Language Model-Based Question and Answer Platform for Solid-State Batteries Using the Model Context Protocol: SSB-Q&A-Platform
V82_REASON: MCP encapsulates SQL, vector and knowledge-graph databases as agents for literature/data question answering and research insight. It is an information-access/Q&A system with no consequential external action or decision-to-effect validity mechanism.
